title: What is Google Gemini?
summary: Explore Google Gemini, the AI model from Google. Learn about its multimodal capabilities, the different versions, and how it compares to other AI models.
body_markdown: Build automations from wherever you work. Describe the outcome you want, and Zapier connects your tools, runs the steps, and stays on the job after you close the chat.
